angle: How marketing-led teams move from tinkering to growth with governance and measurement
sourceTitle: The new growth mandate: A conversation with LinkedIn CMO Jessica Jensen
linkedinPost:
Most AI pilots die of unclear ownership, not bad models.

A McKinsey conversation with LinkedIn’s CMO highlights moving AI from experimentation to growth. Marketing leaders want lift, but only what’s measured and owned survives the quarter.

My take from FDE engagements: set a single commercial KPI per use case, a budgeted ops owner, and a weekly quality gate. If you can’t name the person who will fix drifted prompts or retrain audiences on Tuesday at 3 p.m., it’s not ready for scale.

Practical playbook I’ve seen work: pick one funnel stage, automate the boring 60%, and reinvest the saved time into higher-touch experiments you also measure. Tie every model change to an A/B with a rollback path. Governance sounds slow; it’s how you go faster without redoing work.

Executives: resist vanity dashboards. Ask for impact per seat, time-to-iteration, and the cost of keeping humans-in-the-loop. If these trend the right way, revenue follows.

What’s the one KPI you’d defend to finance as the reason your AI program should exist? #AITransformation #EnterpriseAI #AIAdoption #AIStrategy
